title.en: SAMPLE: An AI checker flags a gap in a published proof
title.zh: SAMPLE：AI 查核工具指出已發表的證明有缺漏

found.en: Marlow Labs says its AI checker, Gapfinder, read a published proof in number theory and flagged a gap in one step.
found.zh: Marlow Labs 表示，它的 AI 查核工具 Gapfinder 讀了一份已發表的數論證明，指出其中一個步驟有缺漏。

matters.en: Mathematicians rely on checks like this to trust long proofs, so a flagged gap needs a careful answer.
matters.zh: 數學家靠這類查核來信任很長的證明，所以被指出的缺漏需要審慎回應。

ai_helped.en: Marlow Labs built Gapfinder, which found the gap with no human help.
ai_helped.zh: Marlow Labs 開發了 Gapfinder，它在沒有人類協助下找出這個缺漏。

how_sure.en: Preprint. arXiv hosts the paper, which has not been peer reviewed. Marlow Labs, the maker of the checker, is the source of the claim.
how_sure.zh: 預印本。論文放在 arXiv 上，尚未經過同儕審查。查核工具的開發者 Marlow Labs 是這項說法的來源。

background.en: A published proof is one that a journal has accepted.
background.zh: 已發表的證明，是指期刊已經接受的證明。

could_lead.en: If the gap is real, the authors could repair the step or withdraw the proof.
could_lead.zh: 如果缺漏屬實，作者可能修補這個步驟，或撤回這份證明。

evidence.quote: The checker found the gap with no human help

note.en: Kestrel College says the authors reject the claim and say the flagged step is correct.
note.zh: Kestrel College 表示，作者否定這項說法，並稱被指出的步驟是正確的。
